label: Comparative Analysis of Circulating Cytokines and Adrenergic Autoantibodies in Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome, Postacute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2, and Healthy Controls.
summary: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) is increasingly recognized after SARS-CoV-2 infection. We compared autonomic phenotype, functional impact, and circulating immune markers in POTS, postacute sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC), and healthy controls. In this cross-sectional study (August 2021 to December 2022), we recruited patients with POTS (n=24) or PASC (n=24) and healthy controls (n=19).
